description: Call this IMMEDIATELY before performing an approved action. Succeeds exactly once per request, only if the request is approved, not past its expiry, and `action` is byte-for-byte the text that was approved. ok:false for any reason means do NOT proceed. An approval cannot be reused for a second or different action.
